en.headline: Customs smash four illicit cigarette stores, seize HK$20 million haul
en.dek: Raids in San Tin, Tsuen Wan and North Point on Tuesday netted about 4.25 million untaxed cigarettes and four arrests, officers said.
body: Hong Kong Customs Revenue and General Investigation Bureau officers carried out a territory-wide operation on Tuesday against the storage and distribution of illicit cigarettes, striking sites in San Tin, Tsuen Wan and North Point, local reports quoting Customs said on Wednesday.

At noon, officers searched a corrugated-iron warehouse in San Tin and seized about 500,000 suspected untaxed cigarettes, arresting a 31-year-old local man who described himself as unemployed. In the afternoon they searched two units in an industrial building on Sha Tsui Road in Tsuen Wan, finding about 800,000 and 2.2 million suspected illicit cigarettes and arresting two unemployed men, aged 27 and 31, who hold Chinese nationality. In the evening a shop space in North Point yielded about 750,000 suspected illicit cigarettes and a 52-year-old unemployed man of Chinese nationality was arrested.

Customs said the four stores together held about 4.25 million illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of about HK$20 million and a duty potential of more than HK$14 million. A seven-seater van suspected of being used for distribution was also seized. Leaflets found at the San Tin warehouse and in the van led officers to believe the group took telephone orders and planned to supply Yuen Long.

Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, dealing with, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes is an offence punishable by a fine of up to HK$2 million and seven years’ imprisonment. Customs reminded the public that buying illicit cigarettes is also illegal.

zh.headline: 海關破四個私煙倉檢425萬支煙 市值約2,000萬拙4人
zh.dek: 人員周二在新田、荃灣及北角採取行動，檢獲約425萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，拘4名男子。
body: 本地傳媒周三引述海關表示，稅收罪案調查科人員周二展開全港性執法行動，分別在新田、荃灣及北角打擊私煙貯存及分發，搗破四個倉庫。
中午，人員突擊搜查新田一個鐵皮倉庫，檢獲約50萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，拘捕一名31歲報稱無業的本地男子。下午在荃灣沙咀道一幢工業大廈兩個單位，分別搜獲約80萬支及約220萬支懷疑私煙，拘捕兩名報稱無業的中國籍男子，分別27歲及31歲。晚上再在北角一個舖位搜出約75萬支懷疑私煙，拘捕一名52歲報稱無業的中國籍男子。
海關表示，四個倉庫合共檢獲約425萬支私煙，估計市值約2,000萬元，應課稅值逾1,400萬元，另檢獲一輛懷疑用作分發的七人車。新田倉庫及車上發現大批私煙傳單，海關相信集團以電話訂購形式運作，並計劃向元朗一帶派貨。
根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙均屬違法，最高可判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。海關提醒市民，購買私煙同樣犯法。
